title: [Action + specific outcome]
objective: Describe the concrete outcome this ticket must deliver.
current_behavior: Describe only behaviour supported by the review record. Clearly identify any detail that still needs repository inspection.
expected_behavior: Describe the observable behaviour after the change.
rationale: Explain why this change is needed and connect it to user or system impact.

implementation_locations.notes: Do not assume this path or symbol exists until inspected.

acceptance_criteria: A specific, observable condition that proves the expected behaviour.
rollback: Describe how to revert the code and any required data, configuration, or runtime changes safely.

owner_approval.note: Approval applies to inclusion in the plan only; it does not authorise implementation.

implementation_plan: Future implementer: inspect the listed source locations and confirm the current behaviour and interfaces before changing code.
Make the smallest coherent change that delivers the expected behaviour.
Add or update the targeted tests described in verification_plan.
Review the eventual change for regressions and scope violations.

required_checks: The future implementation satisfies each acceptance criterion.
The future implementation runs the relevant targeted tests and reports their results.
The future change contains no unrelated scope.

handoff_requirements: Future implementation process should provide a changed-file summary.
Future implementation process should provide exact test commands and results.
Future implementation process should report acceptance-criteria outcomes and deviations.
